title: fix(plugin-auth)!: under invite_only, a self-serve sign-up is admitted only by the invitation it presents
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — under the `invite_only` audience posture an email-and-password sign-up is admitted by an invitation only when it presents that invitation's id as `invitationId` (pending, unexpired, addressed to the sign-up's email), and the address alone is refused `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`; a social OAuth creation is admitted by an invitation only when its identity provider verified the address. The sign-up request widens: `RegisterRequestSchema` and `RegisterRequest` gain `invitationId`, `SignUpData`, `RegisterForm` and the auth context's `signUp` gain it, and `os register` gains `--invitation`.
Metadata-protocol: added — RegisterRequest gains the optional invitationId key (packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json)
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` states the rule, and its out-of-band recovery now sends the row's `id` as `invitationId`; no file under `skills/**` teaches the sign-up request or the invitation carve-out, so no skill or eval moves.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`invite_only`(默认姿态)下,自助注册只凭它出示的邀请放行——注册请求带上邀请链接里的 id(`invitationId`),且该邀请须 pending、未过期、发给同一邮箱;只给邮箱一律按未受邀拒绝,同码同文案,不落任何行。控制台两个注册页、SDK 类型、CLI(`--invitation`)和全部测试夹具都改为携带 id。
- 为什么改:安全加固,规则层表述:`invite_only` 下,自助注册只由它出示的邀请放行。
- 风险与回滚:破坏性收窄——未升级的客户端为受邀者注册时不带 id 会得到 `403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`;首个账号、运营方创建(admin / SCIM / 启动种子)、`open` 与 `email_domain`、魔法链接与邮箱 OTP、SSO 均不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/presented-invitation.ts`(判定本身:按 id 读一行、id 精确比对、pending / 过期 / 地址三项)② `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-membership-admission.ts` 新增的 proof 分支 ③ `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/audience-posture.ts` 的 `invitationProofFor`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/presented-invitation.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 13 passed (13)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The rule.** Under `invite_only`, a self-serve sign-up is admitted only by the invitation it presents. The sign-up sends the invitation's id, the last segment of its `/accept-invitation/` link, as `invitationId` beside `email`, `password` and `name`; the invitation must be pending, unexpired and addressed to that email. No id, an unknown id, an expired or no-longer-pending invitation, another address's invitation, or an id that is not a non-empty string all get the one refusal an uninvited sign-up gets (`403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, same message, same body), and nothing is written. No error code or message is added.

- **`@objectstack/plugin-auth`.** `presented-invitation.ts` answers whether the request presented a pending invitation; `invitationProofFor` (`audience-posture.ts`) decides which creations must present one. The decision stays in `validateAudienceAdmission`, which the `/sign-up/email` before-hook and the `user.validateUserInfo` gate both call with the same endpoint context, so the two cannot disagree. Order unchanged: operator class, bootstrap, invalid posture, invitation, posture — the first account and the boot command's seed still enter without an invitation.
- **Other creation doors under `invite_only`.** Magic link and email OTP create an account only after the mailbox answered, so they keep matching an invitation by address. A social OAuth creation is matched by address only when its identity provider verified the address (`emailVerified: true`); otherwise it gets the uninvited refusal. SSO providers (`allowJit`) are unchanged.
- **Unchanged:** `invite_only` stays the default; `open` and `email_domain` match an invitation by address as before; accepting and listing invitations are unchanged; the boot warning, the verification defaults and `requireEmailVerificationOnInvitation` are unchanged.
- **Accepting and listing.** Under this rule an unverified session at an invited address exists only because its sign-up presented that address's invitation, so what it lists is its own. Narrowing the listing to one id would need the id stored on the account and would hide a second organization's invitation from a real invitee, so the listing stays by address.
- **Rate limiting.** No limiter is added: the sign-up door's existing rate limit and the opt-in Turnstile challenge already front it, and an invitation id is 32 random characters, which cannot be guessed within them.
- **The id travels as one body field.** `RegisterRequestSchema` (`@objectstack/spec`) declares the optional `invitationId`, the key `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` records (`Metadata-protocol: added`, `@objectstack/spec` graded `minor`); the vendor's sign-up body schema keeps an undeclared key and drops it before the row is written (pinned, so a vendor bump that closes the body turns red).
- **Callers.** The Console's `/register` and app-shell's `DefaultRegisterPage` pass the id their `?redirect=/accept-invitation/ID` carries (`invitationIdOf`, now exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`); `RegisterForm` takes an `invitationId` prop, `SignUpData` and the context's `signUp` carry it, and `createAuthClient` sends it in the body. The SDK's `auth.register()` passes it through, typed by the widened `RegisterRequest`. `os register --invitation ID`. The no-mail path is the invitation's **Copy Invite Link** action, whose link carries the same id.
- **Fixtures sign up the way an invitee does.** `inviteForAudienceGate` and `@objectstack/verify`'s harness answer the id they seed, and every fixture sign-up presents it. No request origin is exempted.
- **The release smoke presents it too.** `scripts/publish-smoke.sh` keeps the `id` the operator's invite-member call answers and its invited sign-up sends it as `invitationId`; the uninvited probe still answers `403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`.
- **Texts.** `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`, the boot report's recovery remedy (`boot-sign-in-reachability.ts`) and the checklist's invite recipe (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`, six area items and two area recipes) state the rule; the generated `content/docs/references/api/auth.mdx` follows the schema.
- **Who moves.** Nothing in this repository: the Console, the SDK, the CLI, the `@objectstack/verify` harness and the fixtures all present the id. A client outside it that signs invitees up under `invite_only` sends the accept link's last path segment as `invitationId`. Operators deploy the Console bundle together with the server, hand the link over with **Copy Invite Link** where no mail transport is live, give an out-of-band recovery invitation row an `id` the sign-up sends, and review accounts created before the upgrade that are unverified and hold or accepted an invitation.

BREAKING: under `invite_only`, a client that signs an invitee up sends `invitationId` beside the `email`, `password` and `name` it already sends; the one-line fix is to send the id the invitation link carries.

## Tests

The branch merged `origin/main` at `737b16098b`; each reading names its head under Verification.

- **`presented-invitation.test.ts` (new, 13 cases)** — the real `AuthManager` over ObjectQL + `@objectstack/driver-sql` on better-sqlite3, with invitations written by `/organization/invite-member`: the sign-up that presents its invitation is admitted and the invitee accepts with the invited role; the first account and the boot command's seed enter without one; an address with no invitation, an invited address alone, an unknown id, an expired invitation, a no-longer-pending one, another address's invitation, a non-string id and an empty id each get the identical refusal (status, code, message and body) and leave no `sys_user`, `sys_account` or `sys_member` row; the presented address matches trimmed and lowercased; an address-only attempt does not spend the invitation: the invitee still signs up with the link, and accepts; a copied invitation link carries the id that admits the invitee; the listing still shows the session its own and another organization's pending invitation; an invite-member id is 32 characters of `[a-zA-Z0-9]` and two never match; the vendor sign-up body keeps an undeclared key; a magic-link creation holding an invitation is admitted; an OAuth creation is admitted by its invitation only with `emailVerified: true`; `open` and `email_domain` still match an invitation by address with no id.
- **`audience-posture.test.ts`** — a new top-level `invitationProofFor` matrix (4 cases); the end-of-chain invitation case presents the id; the address probe's own pins (page boundary, narrowed read, folding collation) drive a magic-link creation, the door that keeps the address match.
- **`boot-sign-in-reachability.test.ts`** — the recovery remedy names sending the row's `id` as `invitationId`.
- **`@objectstack/spec` `auth.test.ts`** — `invitationId` is accepted, optional and string-only.
- **`@objectstack/cli` `register-requires-name.test.ts`** — `--invitation` lands in the body as `invitationId`, beside the declared three.
- **UI** — `registerVerificationCallback-10893.test.tsx` pins the wire (`invitationId` on the `/sign-up/email` body, absent when none); both `invitationSignUpJoin-30125.test.tsx` files pin that the console `/register` and `DefaultRegisterPage` send the redirect's invitation id.
- **Fixtures** — every suite that uses `inviteForAudienceGate` (44 files; the two SSO-provider suites keep the address match and carry no id), the direct invitation seeds in plugin-auth, `@objectstack/verify`'s harness, five runtime pins and the client's rotated-token suite present the id they seed.
- **Release smoke** — `bash scripts/publish-smoke.sh` (pack mode, packed tarballs, scaffolded project) at `83438de273`: every probe ok, including `POST /auth/sign-up/email (invited user — presents the invitation) → 200`; lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Control (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleting the body's `invitationId` on disk): `expected HTTP 200, got 403` on that probe; restored, blob equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation (one-off)** — the by-id probe swapped for the by-address one on disk (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `97171743e039` → `0eefd9e8c89d`): `presented-invitation.test.ts` 2 failed / 11 passed (the uniform refusal and the invitee-after-an-address-only-attempt cases). Restored: blob equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty, 13 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`'s `os register` section does not list `--invitation` yet; the command's own flag description and examples do.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts` signs an invitee up without the id against its pinned `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.5` checkout, which predates this rule, so it is unaffected; re-pointed at a release that carries the rule, that sign-up sends the invite's id.
- The changeset writes the request mapping as an **Upgrading.** paragraph, not a `FROM → TO` label: measured, the label reads to `check:adr-0087-registration` as a migration prescription (evidence `from-to-label`) and contradicts the `no-migration-prescription` disposition, and no metadata migrates here.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json` `identity-auth.self-signup-gate` (revision 8) and the `qa-scratch-authz` recipe in `areas/attachments-storage.json` (recipes carry no revision; its provenance records the change) now present the id too.
- The five runtime pins that now present the id also import `@objectstack/metadata` at module top, which `check:test-source-alias` asks of every test file a change edits.
- `invitationIdOf` is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell` so the console's `/register` reads the id with the one helper `DefaultRegisterPage` uses.
